name: connectors-gateway
description: One OAuth-authenticated MCP gateway for cloud and local connectors, with per-user catalogs, policy, approvals, audit, and output redaction.

interface.shortDescription: Secure access to connected cloud and local tools
interface.longDescription: Use one OAuth-authenticated MCP gateway to reach the cloud accounts and local devices you connected. Tool availability is scoped per user and device, while policy checks, approval gates, audit events, and output redaction stay enforced for every action.
defaultPrompt: Use Connectors Gateway to show what I can do with my connected accounts and devices.
Use Connectors Gateway to complete this task with the least-privileged available tool.
Use Connectors Gateway to perform this change, explain its impact, and stop if approval is required.
